title: Preservation of rejection probability
statement: For every natural number $m$, every Boolean input $w$ of length $m+2$, and every Boolean proof $p$ of length $m$, the rejection probability of the short-proof verifier on $(w,p)$ equals the rejection probability of the partial-sum verifier on $(w,p')$, where $p'$ is obtained by appending a final true bit to $p$.
